title: Series B: Unlocking REGENT's Next Phase of Growth | Mare Liberum & AE Ventures
summary: REGENT co-founder and CEO Billy Thalheimer welcomes 600 guests from six continents to Demo Day at REGENT's new Seaglider manufacturing facil
body_markdown: REGENT co-founder and CEO Billy Thalheimer welcomes 600 guests from six continents to Demo Day at REGENT's new Seaglider manufacturing facility in North Kingstown, Rhode Island. Then the co-leads of REGENT's $240 million Series B explain why they invested. Rear Admiral Lorin Selby (Ret.), General Partner, Mare Liberum, makes the case for maritime as an investment theme and for what Seagliders mean for the joint force. Brian Schettler, Partner and Head of AE Ventures, describes why AE Ventures, which had never before invested in a vehicle manufacturer, chose REGENT.
